topic.title: Platform Readiness Considerations

body.p: Intel® Selftest 7 tool supports "Recommended Default Settings" test suite that will collect BIOS configurable settings from a running system then provide recommendations based on the data collector analysis. The tool compares the register values against Intel specifications and displays errors/warnings if it detects mismatch or out-of-range data.
It is recommended to run Selftest 7 on a system before platform workshop and ensure no errors with red flags are detected for quality and stability considerations.
Red Flags: Must correct errors. The settings are considered out-of-spec operation.
Yellow Flags: Further investigation required for optimization.

ul.li: C-state residency counters is '0'. Indicating the processor is not entering the C-state and may not get the best power saving benefits.

Locking down Power and Performance-related configuration on production systems is strongly recommended. Setting lock bits in the Power Limits, Turbo configuration and P-state limit configuration registers prevents end users from altering power and performance settings; this helps ensure system stability and reduces the risk of unintended performance or thermal behavior changes caused by run-time tuning modifications.

li.p: 626935 BIOS-Based Power Delivery Configuration and Override Capabilities Technical Advisory.

body.p: The document gives guidance how to identify the CPU power deliver spec and proper configure the CPU via BIOS setup options.
Refer to the Platform Design Guide for "per-sku" Power Limit and Power Deliver related settings recommendations.
